# Generators and scripts kept outside this tree

Copies of the scripts that build or score corpora living outside the repo,
so the ground truth survives the machine. The working copies stay where the
corpora are; copy back here after changing one.

- `IMGS-v2/generate.sh`: the hard corpus IMGS-ALL2 (`~/Documents/IMGS-v2`).
- `FRESH/generate.sh`: HOLI-DEV / HOLI-TEST variants (`~/Documents/FRESH`).
- `DISC21/`: the DISC21 shard runs and their scoring (`~/Documents/DISC21`).
- MIRFAM's generator is `out/v59-reask/make_mirfam.py`.
